# Corpus Mining: Alex Chiu, *Super I Ching — The Most Powerful Language of God*

**Source PDF**: `/mnt/agents/upload/pdfcoffee.com-super-i-ching-the-most-powerful-language-of-god (1).pdf` (855 pp, Microsoft Word 2016 → ilovepdf, compiled 2019; author metadata "jano"; no printed pagination — citations below are by chapter/section title)
**What it actually is**: NOT a translation of the Zhouyi. It is a self-published course in **Wen Wang Gua / Najia six-line coin divination** (六爻卦), the Song-to-Qing "five stars / six relations" predictive system, heavily simplified and re-branded by Alex Chiu (of magnetic-immortality-ring fame), with a Plum-Blossom-style (Meihua Yishu) trigram correspondence appendix. The classical source it cites is **"The Golden Text" (Huangjin Ce 黃金策)**, the Ming-era Wen Wang Gua manual. Divination answers are event-predictions (money, stocks, court cases, illness, marriage), not moral philosophy.
**Skeptical framing**: The "language of God" claim is Chiu's: "God is the mathematical formula which runs and propels the universe... I-Ching is the most sophisticated and the most dependable language of God nowadays." (section "More about God"). The system's actual primitives are the standard Najia apparatus, recorded below exactly as presented.

---

## 1. PRIMITIVES (recorded exactly)

### 1.1 Cast primitives — 3-coin grammar (Chapter 1)
- Toss 3 identical coins × 6 times, bottom line first, top line last.
- Symbol alphabet (4 tokens):
  - 1 tail + 2 heads → single solid line `—` ("quiet" yang)
  - 2 tails + 1 head → dotted line `- -` ("quiet" yin)
  - 3 tails → `O` = "brightness turning into darkness" (moving yang → becomes dotted)
  - 3 heads → `X` = "darkness turning into brightness" (moving yin → becomes solid)
- `O` and `X` are **"moving lines"**; plain lines are **"quiet lines"**.
- Hexagram = 6 lines; top 3 = top gua, bottom 3 = bottom gua. Hexagrams are looked up in 8 **groups** keyed by bottom gua (e.g. "Quen group"), each group containing 8 hexagrams — the standard 8-palace (bagong) organization.
- **Second hexagram** derived by flipping every moving line; quiet lines copy over. Stars of the 2nd hexagram are assigned by *element-inheritance from the 1st hexagram* ("the 2nd hexagram's stars must follow the nature of the first hexagram").
- Ritual protocol rules: flat surface, coins ~1 inch, no shaking, no distractions, ≤3–4 tosses/day, sincerity required; "Once you are sure about what is going to happen in the future, you can no longer get an accurate sign... your thinking is not pure anymore."

### 1.2 The annotation grid (the "chart" written beside each cast)
Columns: **Hiders | Stars | Elements | Lines | Yourself/Opponent (J/U)**; plus header: Year/Month/Date (in Chinese calendar characters) + **Empty Dates**.
- **J** = self line (世爻 shi), **U** = opponent/enemy line (應爻 ying). Fixed per hexagram (e.g. J on 2nd, U on 5th for [Combine]).
- **Hiders** (伏神 fushen): stars/elements absent from the drawn hexagram but present in its group-palace; "If there are elements which you cannot find in your first hexagram, they are hiding. So look for the hiders!"

### 1.3 The 5 Stars (六親 six relations, compressed to five) — section "The 5 Stars"
Alex Chiu's letter code / other schools' names / semantics:
- **P** = Parent ("Set up"): parents, teachers, bosses; buildings, documents, contracts, books, the universe, systems — "something COMPLEX"; also worry, fear, being set up, news.
- **B** = Brother/Sibling ("Action"): brothers, friends, helpers, same-status competitors; "the money killer" — waste, theft, destruction of property; also sound/talking.
- **K** = Kid/Child ("You got nothing"): children, students, followers; happiness, disappearance of worry, medicine/cure/doctor; irresponsibility; "K kills R."
- **G** = Girl/Gold = Asset/Wealth ("Gain"): money, stocks, treasure, pets, wife/loved woman, new ideas/plans, popularity.
- **R** = Officer/Judge ("You got something"): power, control, possession; husband, judge, police, robber, corpse, examiner; also trouble, worry, serious illness.
Gloss variants recorded in the book's own glossary: Alex Chiu (P/B/K/G/R = Parent, Brother, Kid, Girl/Gold, Officer); Jack Chiu (Parent, Sibling, Child, Asset, Officer); "Other" (Parent, Brother, Children/Descendant, Woman/Wealth, Officer/Ghost).
**Selection rule**: choose the **"appointed" star** (用神 yongshen) matching the question's target — e.g. sister → B star, money → G, son → K, house → P, exam/fame → R or P.

### 1.4 The 12 Dates (Earthly Branches) — Chapter 2
10 upper dates (I–X, Heavenly Stems, "not as important") + **12 lower dates**: t c y m cn e w wa s yo sh h (zi chou yin mao chen si wu wei shen you xu hai). Each carries an element: t,h = water · c,cn,wa,sh = soil · y,m = wood · e,w = fire · s,yo = metal. The 12 letters are simultaneously **years, months, dates, and 2-hour hours** (with animal signs: Mouse, Cow, Tiger, Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Sheep, Monkey, Chicken, Dog, Pig). Month and Date of the toss set the strength field for every line.

### 1.5 The 6 Animals / 6 Colors (六神)
Murky Waters/Black Tortoise (Xuan Wu, black) · White Tiger (Bai Hu, white) · Flying Serpent (Teng She, grey) · Curvy Array (Gou Chen, yellow) · Vermilion Bird (Zhu Que, red) · Azure Dragon (Qing Long, green). Assigned to lines 1–6 from the day stem via the "6 Colors Chart" (1st line green under stems I/II, red under III/IV, etc.). "Nobody knows who discovered" them (end-matter note).

### 1.6 Relation operators between branches/elements (end-of-book reference chart)
- **Kill/produce cycles**: "Fire kills metal. Metal kills wood. Wood kills soil. Soil kills water. And water kills fire." (production cycle used for "producing the self line" judgments).
- **Bondages** (六合): t+c→soil · y+h→wood · m+sh→fire · cn+yo→metal · e+s→water · w+wa→soil. "Bounding and matching means that things will work out... But you cannot put the bounding law before the killing and producing law." A bound line is "tied up and cannot move" until the bond is **"struck open"** by the striking element/day ("when there is a bondage, it must be broken with a strike for it to become effective" — cited to "The Golden Text"). Special case: "bound and kill" — if the binder also kills the bound element, no bond exists (e.g. weak t water in soil month is "buried").
- **Strikes** (六沖): t–w · m–yo · c–wa · cn–sh · y–s · e–h.
- **Combos** (三合 three-harmony): s+t+cn = water · y+w+sh = fire · e+yo+c = metal · h+m+wa = wood. "I think this chapter is the heart of this entire book" (combos chapter).
- **Traps**: y traps e, e traps s, s traps y (1st set); three t trap one m, one m traps three t (2nd set); c traps sh, sh traps wa; c, w, yo, h trap themselves.
- **Empty Dates** (空亡 xun/kong): per day-pair chart, two branches are "empty"; lines holding empty characters "remain inactive or ineffective until it is fulfilled" — activated when the year/month/date/hour of the character arrives or when it is **struck**.
- **Strength scale per element** (Healthy in / Strongest in / Weak in / Buried-in-Grave / Disappear in): e.g. Wood — healthy sh,h,t,c; strongest y,m; weak cn,e,w; buried wa; disappears s,yo. Metal strongest wa,s,yo; buried c; disappears y,m,w; etc. (full 5-row table in chart).

### 1.7 Hexagram-type primitives
- **6-strike hexagrams** (六沖卦): "6 strike means separate. In a 6 strike hexagram, every line is striking at another line." A 6-strike turning into a 6-match = things turn out after initial failure.
- **6-match hexagrams** (六合卦): all lines bonded; "usually nothing bad will happen."
- **Permanent 6 strike**: certain palace positions are inherently striking.
- Moving-line transformations: a moving line produces/kills other lines; may "advance" (轉進) or "retreat" (轉退) through its own element sequence; a moving line bound to month/date is frozen until struck loose; "a non-moving line will act like a moving line when the bondage [is struck]" [mechanism as stated in the text, terminology loose]; dead elements can still "kill back" (chapter "Strength of month and date").

### 1.8 The 8 Guas correspondence table (appended "Chapter 3: The 8 Guas", Meihua-style)
Branch→gua assignment: t→Kan; c,y→Gen; m→Zen(Zhen); cn,e→Shun(Xun); w→Li; wa,s→Quen(Qian? [as printed: "wa (soil) and s (metal) are found in Quen"]); yo→Duay(Dui); sh,h→Chen(Qian) [naming is idiosyncratic/romanized; printed exactly as in book].
Each gua gets a full slot list — **Weather / Geography / Characters / Personalities / Body parts / Time / Objects / Animals / Buildings / Family / Food / Marriage / Job / Goal / Trade / Travel / Meeting / Disease / Legal / Grave / Colour / Number / Taste** — e.g. **Chen (Qian)**: "heaven... hard, dense, rare, expensive, metal, justice, center, power and control"; NW; head/bone/lungs; autumn; horse/crane/lion/elephant; spicy; lucky in autumn & spring, unlucky summer. **Quen (Kun)**: "soft cheap soil... darkness, woman, large"; SW; waist/stomach; cow/camel; square objects; etc. (8 complete entries in PDF end-matter).

## 2. RULES (count ≈ 40 explicit rule statements; representative core below)

R1. 6 tosses, bottom-up build. R2. O/X generate second hexagram by flipping. R3. 2nd-hexagram stars inherit by element from 1st. R4. Record month+date+empty dates (year/hour optional). R5. Choose appointed star by question type. R6. Judge strength of appointed/self line from month+date elements (kill/produce/healthy/buried/disappear). R7. Month can kill while date produces → net assessment required. R8. Bonded moving line frozen until struck open. R9. Bound+killed = no bond. R10. Empty lines inert until fulfilled or struck. R11. K kills R; B kills G (money); etc. — star-interaction matrix follows element relations. R12. Moving star produces/kills its target lines; money star must "produce the self line" for gain. R13. 6-strike = separation; 6-match = cohesion; 6-strike→6-match = eventual success. R14. Hiders supply missing stars/elements. R15. "If the appointed is weak like hell, what good is the bounding and matching?" — kill/produce law outranks bond/match law. R16. Sincerity/focus rules (no re-tossing a clear sign; breaks between tosses; ≤3–4/day). R17. Time-zone rule: convert to Beijing time; date shift between hour t and h. R18. Timing answers read off activation moments (bond struck open at hour m → birth at hour m, etc.).

---

## 3. SYNTAX / STRATA OBSERVATIONS

- The system is a **fully positional slot-machine**: [hider | star | element | animal | line-form | J/U] × 6 positions + temporal header (month/date/empty) + derived 2nd hexagram. The classical Zhouyi text (judgments/line texts) is **entirely absent** — replaced by hexagram *names* used as lookup labels ([Combine], [Strip], [Advance], [Travel], [Queen]... — Chiu's own English renamings of the 64).
- Time is the valuation engine: month/date are a **strength field** applied to every line; future times (year/month/date/hour of a branch) are **activation triggers** (fulfilling empties, striking bonds open) — predictions are timed by the trigger calendar.
- Two-layer event logic: static relations (kill/produce) set possibility; dynamic events (move/bond/strike/empty) set timing.
- Correspondence tables: 12 dates × element × month × animal × hour (transcribed in §1.4/§1.6); element strength table (§1.6); bond/strike/combo/trap tables (§1.6); 6-color × day-stem × line chart (§1.5); 8 gua × 23-slot correspondence lists (§1.8).

## 6. UNCERTAINTIES
- [uncertain] Chiu's gua names (Chen/Quen/Zen/Shun/Duay...) are idiosyncratic romanizations; mapping to standard Qian/Kun/Zhen/Xun/Dui/Kan/Gen/Li inferred from element/branch assignments, and his branch→gua table departs from the standard Najia assignment in places [as printed; flagged].
- [uncertain] The hexagram English names ([Combine], [Strip], etc.) are Chiu's coinages, not received translations.
- The book is compilatory (855 pp, many repeated lesson-examples); rule statements are scattered and sometimes contradictory — inventory above covers the explicit rule layer, not the hundreds of case annotations.
